summary: Frontend-only re-verification after iteration_16's HIGH issue was fixed (SEOHead now rendered on /contact and on both form + results views of AI Assessment / ROI Calculator). All requested checks PASS. Every one of 13 SPA routes now sets a unique document.title AND emits a matching GA page_view where page_title == document.title (no stale-title lag). Meta description + canonical present on /contact, /ai-assessment, /roi-calculator, /smart-calendar; /contact carries a valid ContactPage JSON-LD. Tool pages keep their titles on the results screen (single <title> tag, no flicker). Both tool submissions land in Admin (TEST_ROI_1786009618 in Admin -> ROI Calculators, TEST_AI_1786009783 in Admin -> AI Assessments). Service lists are resynced to the 6 current services on both the ROI Calculator and the Smart Calendar dropdown — retired options ('Digital Transformation', 'Operational Optimization', 'Business Strategy Development', 'Risk Management & Compliance') are GONE from both. Regressions still pass: gtag loader for G-F48RFBBEP7 present; both G-F48RFBBEP7 and GT-NSSVHXXP configured in dataLayer; Consent Mode v2 default denied on fresh session, granted after cookie-accept-btn, persisted after reload (localStorage 'orgainse_consent'='accepted' and consent default reflects analytics_storage:granted); ServicePopup closes on Escape; Healthcare Revenue Intelligence popup renders both service-not-included-* and service-who-we-serve-* while the other five popups render NEITHER. No 5xx / no console errors introduced by this round.
critical_code_review_comments: SmartCalendar dropdown labels the AI services as 'Artificial Intelligence & Workflow Transformation' and 'Artificial Intelligence Strategy & Readiness' (no 'AI/' prefix), while the ROI Calculator uses shortened 'AI & Workflow Transformation' / 'AI Strategy & Readiness'. The review spec ('AI/Artificial Intelligence & Workflow Transformation' etc.) matches both semantically, but the two forms are inconsistent with each other and with the footer nav. Cosmetic only — not blocking, but worth aligning on one wording.

RouteAnalytics uses a 400 ms setTimeout to give SEOHead time to update document.title before it pushes page_view. This works reliably here, but it silently breaks if a future page mounts SEOHead behind a Suspense/async boundary. Consider using an explicit useEffect-driven title-updated signal instead of a fixed timeout.
seed_data_creation: Two disposable leads created for verification: ROI record 'TEST_ROI_1786009618' (Admin -> ROI Calculators) and AI Assessment record 'TEST_AI_1786009783' (Admin -> AI Assessments). Both are TEST_-prefixed and safe to delete.
